'''Takayuki Masuda''' (Japanese: '''増田隆之''' ''Masuda Takayuki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Masuda was born on January 16, 1984, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where he voiced [[Goh]]'s father [[Walker]].

* Shin Nemoto (''{{wp|My Hero Academia}}'')
* Harz Lecter (''{{wp|Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 2199}}'')
* Munetaka Murasako, Yasuzou Muramatsu, Towada (''{{wp|Shiki}}'')
